milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting oak planks from oak logs results in oak_planks appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with oak_log but no oak_planks, so any oak_planks in inventory confirms successful crafting. 1 log yields 4 planks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting birch planks from birch logs results in birch_planks appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with birch_log but no birch_planks, so any birch_planks in inventory confirms successful crafting. 1 log yields 4 planks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The orange tulips are at (7, 0, 9) relative to spawn (~11.4 blocks from spawn, behind oak leaf hedge barrier). max_distance=5 requires the player to walk to within 5 blocks of the tulips, confirming navigation past the hedge into the garden area. facing_tolerance=60 ensures intentional observation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted red mushroom is inside the oak cabin at (17, 1, 9) relative to spawn (~19.2 blocks from spawn). max_distance=5 requires entering the cabin through the north wall entrance. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the pot.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch slabs are at (-8, 0, -10) relative to spawn (~12.8 blocks from spawn) inside the birch building corridor. max_distance=5 requires entering the building and walking into the corridor section.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cyan banner is at (-9, 1, -8) relative to spawn (~12.0 blocks from spawn) mounted on a support block inside the birch building. max_distance=5 requires entering the building interior. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the banner.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dead horn coral fan is at (10, 0, 10) relative to spawn (~14.1 blocks from spawn) in the water feature beyond the tulip garden. max_distance=5 requires approaching the water pool closely. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the coral.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The gray terracotta floor is in the back room of the birch building. Target set to (-9, 0, -12) at y=0 (air level above the terracotta floor at y=-1) so the facing check doesn't require an unnaturally steep downward gaze. ~15.0 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 requires walking deep into the building's back section.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The orange concrete powder is at (-10, 0, -13) relative to spawn (~16.4 blocks from spawn), the deepest point in the north wing birch building. max_distance=5 requires full traversal of the building interior to the back wall.
